Dear Marc,

Thank you for the time you, Shawne, Josh and Ian gave us at your office on October 2. This proposal accompanies the enclosed engagement letter and describes how Onyx Accounting Group would support George Brazil following your CFO's departure.

We have organized it around what we heard. The first priority is continuity: keeping the monthly close, Bell Bank reporting and the day-to-day accounting on track while supporting and training Ian. Behind that sits the work that needs controller and CFO judgment, including the 401(k) plan audit, the year-end financial audit, a smoother accounts payable process, cleaner flows between ServiceTitan, QStock and Sage Intacct, and planning for the S corporation conversion in 2028.
Our fees are hourly at the rates in Section 05. You pay for the hours worked, and the mix of controller, CFO and staff time can be changed by email as your needs change. There is no minimum term.
We would welcome the opportunity to work with your team and are glad to meet again to walk through any part of this proposal.

Onyx Accounting Group is a Scottsdale, Arizona accounting firm that provides bookkeeping, controller and CFO services to privately held companies. We work inside our clients' own systems, including Sage Intacct and QuickBooks, as an extension of their finance team, and we are built to cover the full range from transaction detail to the owner's table.
Big-firm background
Our leadership held Director and Manager roles at top 10 national accounting firms and brings that standard of review and documentation to privately held companies.
Industry experience
Construction and the trades, real estate and property management, professional services, distribution and retail, and hospitality.
Ownership structures
Owner-led, private equity backed and family office companies, including lender, investor and audit reporting.
Scottsdale team
Engagement leadership, the controller and CFO roles, every judgment call, and on-site time in Phoenix for onboarding and training.
Supporting staff
Reconciliations, schedules and transaction support prepared on our systems by accountants with ten or more years of experience, and reviewed in Scottsdale.
Perform and review
The person who prepares a number is never the person who approves it. Every reconciliation, journal entry and report is reviewed by a second accountant before it reaches you.
One file, not one person
Procedures, the close checklist and the open-items list live in a shared file your team can see, so nothing depends on a single individual.

The principal leads the engagement and stays on it. Jessica Bumphus, who joined us at the October 2 meeting, leads the controller work. Staff support is assigned at kickoff, and the mix is adjusted with you as the work settles.

Our understanding of George Brazil

**AJAC, Inc. dba George Brazil Plumbing & Electrical, Phoenix.** Residential plumbing and electrical service, in Arizona since 1990 and part of a name in home services that dates to 1955. Employee-owned through an ESOP.
**Finance team.** Marc Erpenbeck, President. Ian, in-house accountant, runs the day-to-day. The CFO departed on October 2.
**Systems.** Sage Intacct (general ledger), ServiceTitan (field service and point of sale), QStock (inventory), BambooHR and TRAX (HR and weekly payroll), Bill.com under evaluation for AP.
**Banking and structure.** Bell Bank, with quarterly reporting. C corporation today, with a planned conversion back to an S corporation in 2028. Annual financial audit and a 401(k) plan audit.
Continuity of the finance function now, without waiting for a hire to ramp up.
Controller leadership of the monthly close, with review of the day-to-day work and training for Ian.
Management and Bell Bank reporting that is accurate and on time.
Less manual work between ServiceTitan, QStock and Sage Intacct, and a smoother accounts payable process.
CFO guidance on budgeting, forecasting, the audits and the 2028 S corporation conversion.

Compared with a single full-time hire
Continuity
You work with a team, not one individual. If a person changes, the file, the procedures and your senior contact do not.
Depth
CFO, controller and staff expertise under one engagement, with a built-in review process so the work is completed accurately and consistently.
Flexibility
Phase work in, pause a project, scale back or expand by email. No penalties and no paperwork to redo. You pay only for hours worked.
Fit
We work alongside Ian, your tax preparer, your auditor and Bell Bank, and we keep approvals with you. Stabilizing a close and the systems behind it is what we do every day.
Review
